title: Minimax ATE Estimation under Huber Contamination and Weak Overlap
banked_reason: The proposal promised an explicit matched frontier on every declared (d, alpha, beta, kappa) class, but the derived contribution is limited to d=1, beta=1, alpha>=1 and leaves all other coordinates open.
gap_reasons: The proposal promised an explicit matched frontier on every declared (d, alpha, beta, kappa) class, but the derived contribution is limited to d=1, beta=1, alpha>=1 and leaves all other coordinates as this open question.
The unresolved coordinates are d>1, beta!=1, or alpha<1, including their interactions and every logarithm on the remaining equality surfaces.
proof_attempt_summary: The run derived and referee-checked a finite dyadic estimator with matching clean and Huber-collision lower bounds for d=1, beta=1, alpha>=1 and every kappa>0, including the kappa=1 logarithmic elbow. It also retained a general ATE total-variation modulus and projected-bias identity. The frozen kernel nevertheless required the explicit matched frontier for every d, alpha, beta, and kappa; robust high-resolution nuisance/Gram estimation, matching converses, interactions, and equality-surface logarithms remain unproved, so D0.5 classified the narrowed result as kernel substitution.
tldr: On the exact one-dimensional boundary class with Lipschitz outcome regressions and propensity calibration smoothness at least one, one total finite dyadic cell estimator attains the same-experiment minimax risk \(r_{n,\kappa}+\epsilon^{2/(\kappa+2)}\) for every \(\kappa>0\). The clean term is parametric below \(\kappa=1\), equals \(\{\log(en)/n\}^{1/2}\) at the elbow, and is \(n^{-2/(\kappa+3)}\) above it. The theorem proves that clean minimax functional rate and the contamination modulus are simultaneously attainable on this subfamily; the higher-dimensional or non-Lipschitz smoothness interactions remain open.
gap: Section 3 and Appendix B, Proposition B.1 of MaSantAnnaSasakiUra2026 analyze trimming and boundary bias correction under clean i.i.d. sampling, while robust causal estimators treat narrower outcome corruption under stronger overlap and generic Huber theory does not preserve fast scalar-functional structure. No located theorem gives a computable same-class minimax equality when the propensity vanishes quadratically and \(Q\) may replace \(X\), \(A\), and \(Y\).
fill: The dyadic estimator uses variable-width cells, bounded zero-count-safe arm means, and a reused first slab to attain \(n^{-2/5}+\epsilon^{1/2}\). Exact clean-law pairs certify the clean and contamination lower bounds, and the remaining multidimensional projection frontier is stated separately as open content.
